_comment: Rights register for audio, video and image files. Read the header of scripts/media-rights-gate.py for the rule.

`baseline` is every in-scope audio, video and raster/vector image file tracked on 2026-11-15. The 13 legacy SVGs omitted from the first inventory were added in this correction; all baseline files remain UNREVIEWED, not rights-cleared.
Shrink the baseline by moving a file to `records` with its real source, creator, licence and evidence. Never add files created after 2026-11-15 to the baseline: a new file needs a record.
`observations` are things seen in the files themselves, recorded so they are not lost. They are not rights claims.

licence_notes.owner-original: made by the owner (a photograph, a drawing, a recording); no one else's work in it
licence_notes.owner-generated: produced with an AI tool under the owner's own account: name the tool and its terms in `source`, and keep the receipt or terms page as `evidence`
licence_notes.PD: public domain, with `evidence` that is the URL stating so
licence_notes.licensed-commercial: bought or licensed; `evidence` is a URL to the licence or receipt page

observations.seen: a 'Veo' watermark is visible in the lower right of the frame
observations.meaning: the image appears to come from a generative video tool; that tool's terms govern use and the owner should confirm them. The reel-NN.mp4 files beside it are probably the same origin. Unconfirmed.

records.source: Original SVG artwork authored with OpenAI ChatGPT assistance specifically for the SYD OMEGA 91717 Genesis World feature; no third-party artwork or external asset was imported.
records.creator: OpenAI ChatGPT (AI-assisted original vector authoring), commissioned for the SYD OMEGA 91717 project.
records.evidence: Conversation generation context and the Git commit history for this asset; retain this provenance record with the source.

records.source: Original SVG drawn as code with Anthropic Claude (Claude Code) assistance for the SYD OMEGA 91717 Legion of Wisdom seal; every shape, gradient and path is authored in the file itself. A concept render supplied by the owner (an AI-generated image) was used as a visual reference for composition only; no pixel, path or text was copied or traced from it, and no third-party artwork or stock asset was imported.
records.creator: Anthropic Claude (AI-assisted original vector authoring), commissioned for the SYD OMEGA 91717 project.
records.evidence: Conversation context and the Git commit history for this asset; retain this record with the source. Whether purely AI-authored artwork is protected by copyright varies by jurisdiction and is not asserted here; the owner's counsel should confirm before the seal is relied on as a registered mark.
